title: FirstMate workflow definition
description: A workflow is a small state machine of named steps. `bin/fm-workflow validate` enforces this schema (its structural half is evaluated by a jq subset validator, so no schema library is needed) plus the rules a schema cannot express: roles exist, every transition target exists, every outcome of a step is routed, every step is reachable, and every cycle passes through a loop that has a limit. `x-outcomes` is a non-standard keyword read by the engine: the outcomes each output contract can produce.

version.description: Bump on every behavior change; a running task keeps the version it started with (its state file pins the definition).

when.description: What kind of task selects this workflow: the Captain's selection guidance, read by `fm-workflow list`.

roles.description: Alias -> role under roles/. Steps bind to an alias, so swapping the agent for a kind of work is one edit here.

target.description: A step name, the reserved @complete (the workflow succeeded) or @escalate (stop and hand the accumulated feedback to the captain), or {to, loop} to take the transition inside a named loop.

maxIterations.description: How many times a transition tagged with this loop may be taken. The attempt after that is not taken: onExhausted applies.

onExhausted.description: Never a silent stop and never a silent pass: escalate hands the accumulated feedback to the captain.

from.description: task: the task text the workflow was started with. change: the change under work, as the last step that recorded one gave it. report: the latest recorded report of `step`. feedback: the latest still-open feedback list produced by any of `steps`, verbatim.

optional.description: Omit the input silently when nothing is available yet (feedback on a first run).

kind.description: work: a worker with the step's role runs it. decision: the orchestrator decides, by the stated criteria. deliver: Firstmate delivers through the task's own delivery mode; it is never a role.

role.description: A key of the workflow's roles map (work steps only).

output.description: report: free-form report, outcome reported by the orchestrator (done or blocked). verdict: the report ends with the machine-readable verdict block and the outcome is parsed from it, never supplied by the caller.

on.description: Outcome -> target. A work step routes every outcome of its output contract (x-outcomes); a deliver step routes done and blocked; a decision step's keys are its choices.
